messages.text: Map the chain from a AI market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Oscilloscope.

| AI market requirement | Measurable parameter / validation item | Required Oscilloscope capability |
|---|---|---|
| AI server trend pushes PCB toward high layer count, large area, and high-speed transmission [10]. | High-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow includes IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram and TDR Impedance [50]. | Oscilloscope is required as part of high-speed electrical interface testing because Slide 11 maps Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [50]. |
| AI server PCBA / motherboard mapping includes PDN Target Z, power rail, multiphase DC, and PI needs [17]. | Power Distribution Network is a validation block, and PDN is mapped to scopes and network analyzers [50]. | Oscilloscope must support PDN / power-rail / multiphase DC / PI analysis; the AISeverEcosystem mapping lists MXO for power rail / multiphase DC / PI [17]. |

- [[CommScope Rapid Fiber Connect Platform]] — 來源稱其 simplifies and accelerates AI scaling by pre-integrating optics off-site and reducing on-site fiber connections。

- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 AI伺服器趨勢推升 [[PCB]] 邁向高層數、大面積與高速傳輸，供應鏈全面翻新。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 [[AWS Trainium 2 Max]]、[[Google TPU V6]]、[[Meta MTIA 2]] 量產，並稱 2026年新平台將陸續推出。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 [[HVLP銅箔]] 進入第4、5代，[[CCL]] 以 [[M8]] 為主，導入低介電、低損耗與高散熱設計。

- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 TPCA Show 焦點聚焦玻纖布、HVLP銅箔、CCL 發展與高縱深比設備，反映材料與製程全面升級。

- [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）與 [[HSD PCB image 1]] 高度重疊，同樣以「GB200/GB300/VR200規格：南亞和臻鼎為亮點」為標題，右上角標示「資料來源：產業調研、福邦投顧整理」。

- [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）列出 [[GB300]] 使用 **HVLP3銅箔**，[[VR200]] 使用 **HVLP4銅箔**，並將 [[VR200]] 交換板 CCL 材料列為 **M8(LDK2+HVLP4) 生益科技/台光電/南亞(交期最快)**。
